text:
I had a slightly loose tooth extracted. They quoted 300-1,000 baht per tooth, depending on the difficulty (it was a lower tooth, not a molar). The procedure took 5 minutes, including anesthesia, but excluding X-ray time.
The dentist was very quick. The charge was 600 baht for the extraction and 150 baht for the X-ray. If it's only 600 baht for an easy extraction, what could it be for that price??... Overall, the service was standard and quick.
